info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-List Careers Applications Jobs-v5-spec
info.description: The Career Applications Management API allows users to access and retrieve a comprehensive list of job applications submitted through the careers platform. This endpoint is designed for recruiters and hiring managers who need to manage candidate applications efficiently. By leveraging this API, users can filter, sort, and analyze applications, enhancing the recruitment process. Typical consumers include HR professionals and recruitment software integrations looking to streamline their hiring workflows.

get.summary: Retrieve a list of job applications.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch all job applications submitted by users. You can utilize various query parameters to filter the results based on your needs.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve job applications. Make sure to provide the necessary filters or parameters according to the API specifications.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the list of job applications.
